summary: The note announces the Youth Talent Show, "Discovering Our Neighborhood's Rising Stars," on September 15, 2023 at the town hall. Young performers aged 7 to 18 will compete before a judges panel with host Jake Morrison. The event also includes workshops, interactive booths, a buffet, and fundraising for the community arts program.
one_line: Announcement of the September 15, 2023 youth talent show at the town hall, featuring a host, three judges, booths, a buffet, and arts fundraising.
key_facts: The Youth Talent Show, "Discovering Our Neighborhood's Rising Stars," is scheduled for September 15, 2023.
The event takes place at the town hall, starting at 6 PM sharp.
Jake Morrison, a local celebrity, returns as the host for the evening.
The judges are Rachel Nguyen, a Broadway veteran; Michael Brooks, a local music producer; and Jessica Wells, a former talent show winner who made it big in the dance world.
Participants are between the ages of 7 and 18 and are guided by volunteer coaches from the local arts community.
Acts range from singing and dancing to magic, musical instrument mastery, acting monologues, and acrobatic stunts.
Past alumni include Lily Gordon, now touring with a national dance company, and the Hernandez Brothers, a music duo recording their debut album after being discovered at the event.
Participants take workshops on stage presence, public speaking, and resilience needed in the performing arts.
Local businesses sponsor the event, providing giveaways and contributing to the grand prize for the most outstanding act.
The event is a fundraiser for the community arts program.
Halfway through the program, former participants who have achieved success will address the audience.
The foyer will become an interactive zone with art activities, instruments to try, and impromptu dance-offs, plus booths from local arts and crafts vendors.
A buffet of dishes from local eateries representing diverse cuisines will be served.
Tickets are described as selling fast.
